name: lift_cube_wide
instruction: lift the cube off the table

success.rubric: The cube is clear of the table by at least 4 cm and held in the gripper. A cube nudged off the edge or dropped immediately does not count.

metadata.note: Same task as lift_cube over a start region three times wider. A policy that scores well here and not there has learned the task; one that scores well there and not here has learned a position.
